enchantments.tooltip: Strength +7: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Constitution +2: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +60 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Knight's Loyalty: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +3 artifact bonus to your To-Hit and Damage rolls, and a +3 Insight bonus to Natural Armor.
